notes: TARGET R103d (Loyalty currency consistency) is a hybrid-mode requirement addressing alignment of loyalty point accrual, redemption, and tier management with financial consistency expectations. PRIMARY evidence (E1-E9) establishes core loyalty operations: points earned on completed+paid rents, immediate balance updates, redemption validation, tier automation, and transaction recording. CONTEXT evidence (E10-E17) reveals critical gaps: multi-currency billing presentation is unspecified (E11, E17), financial consistency across reporting contexts is questioned (E12), and precision/rounding in currency handling lacks detail (E10, E16). The requirement title emphasizes CURRENCY CONSISTENCY, which is not fully addressed in the loyalty-specific rules but is heavily implicated by AFFECTS relations to currency and billing gaps (E10, E11, E12, E13). Two explicit conflicts exist (E6, E8) with accrual logic implementations. The operative context captures the core loyalty behaviors from PRIMARY evidence; gaps and uncertainties capture the unresolved currency/consistency dimensions that the requirement title signals are in scope. Filtered abstract or low-relevance operative statements: System shall support configurable loyalty tiers and assign tiers based on configured thresholds | Loyalty currency consistency requires that user-facing loyalty totals and presented discounts align with underlying financial records across all billing contexts
